tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated service health, version, and validated published-data counts.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List every language served by AirFreightPrice, with native name and URL prefix pattern.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Return verified COSERVA LTD and portal contact information. VAT and phones are intentionally not supplied.

tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Search route pages by origin/destination free text. Accent-, case-, synonym-, and stem-tolerant; returns canonical URL, language variants, and IATA only when published.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get one published lane's airport IATA evidence, typical carriers, transit wording, canonical URL and .md URL. Prices/transit are never inferred; missing values are null with a note.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: Look up a published airport page by IATA code or name, with canonical URL and only explicitly linked lanes.

tools.name: get_carrier
tools.description: Look up a published cargo-carrier page by IATA/name, with canonical URL and only explicitly linked lanes.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Return published FAQ markdown, language-aware. Optional query/topic filters matching lines without inventing answers.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a quote inquiry through the exact WordPress afp_lead pipeline. Returns the portal-issued lead_uid; channel is always mcp. Do not send secrets or payment data. A name/company starting with TEST or TESTAS, or test=true, blocks real delivery (returns test_blocked) for safe integration testing.

tools.name: get_rate_reference
tools.description: Return dated, published AirFreightPrice rate-reference, methodology, and data-sources pages. No rate figures are invented or derived.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_inquiry" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Submit a quote inquiry through the exact WordPress afp_lead pipeline. Returns the portal-issued lead_uid; channel is always mcp. Do not send secrets or payment …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_languages, search_routes, get_route, get_airport, get_carrier · Private data: get_company_info, create_inquiry · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_languages, search_routes, get_route, get_airport, get_carrier · Private data: get_company_info, create_inquiry · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
